staff2.groupInfo.Engineers: They design and develop the bike: projects, electronics, aerodynamics and tyres.
staff2.groupInfo.Mechanics: Each rider's box crew: the lead mechanic looks after reliability and the race engineer sets the bike up and makes the race calls.
staff2.groupInfo.Strategists: They read the race and look after the people: data and forecasts, scouting, coaching, physio and marketing.
